sn6.14:2.1: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave rājā ahosi aruṇavā nāma.
sn6.14:2.2: rañño kho pana bhikkhave aruṇavato aruṇavatī nāma rājadhānī ahosi.
sn6.14:2.3: aruṇavatiṃ kho pana bhikkhave rājadhāniṃ sikhī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho upanissāya vihāsi.
sn6.14:2.4: sikhissa kho pana bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa abhibhū sambhavaṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ ahosi aggayugaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.
sn6.14:2.5: atha kho bhikkhave sikhī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho abhibhuṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantesi
sn6.14:2.6: āyāma brāhmaṇa yena aññataro brahmaloko tenupasaṅkamissāma yāva bhattassa kālo bhavissatīti.
sn6.14:2.7: evaṃ bhanteti kho bhikkhave abhibhū bhikkhu sikhissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa paccassosi.
sn6.14:2.8: atha kho bhikkhave sikhī ca bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho abhibhū ca bhikkhu seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya evameva aruṇavatiyā rājadhāniyā antarahitā tasmiṃ brahmaloke pāturahesuṃ.
sn6.14:3.1: atha kho bhikkhave sikhī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho abhibhuṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantesi
sn6.14:3.2: paṭibhātu brāhmaṇa brahmuno ca brahmaparisāya ca brahmapārisajjānañca dhammī kathāti.
sn6.14:3.3: evaṃ bhanteti kho bhikkhave abhibhū bhikkhu sikhissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa paṭissutvā brahmānañca brahmaparisañca brahmapārisajje ca dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
sn6.14:3.4: tatra sudaṃ bhikkhave brahmā ca brahmaparisā ca brahmapārisajjā ca ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
sn6.14:3.5: acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhūtaṃ vata bho kathañhi nāma satthari sammukhībhūte sāvako dhammaṃ desessatīti.
sn6.14:4.1: atha kho bhikkhave sikhī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho abhibhuṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantesi
sn6.14:4.2: ujjhāyanti kho te brāhmaṇa brahmā ca brahmaparisā ca brahmapārisajjā ca
sn6.14:4.3: acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhūtaṃ vata bho kathañhi nāma satthari sammukhībhūte sāvako dhammaṃ desessatīti
sn6.14:4.4: tenahi tvaṃ brāhmaṇa bhiyyoso mattāya brahmānañca brahmaparisañca brahmapārisajje ca saṃvejehīti.
sn6.14:4.5: evaṃ bhanteti kho bhikkhave abhibhū bhikkhu sikhissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa paṭissutvā dissamānenapi kāyena dhammaṃ desesi adissamānenapi kāyena dhammaṃ desesi dissamānenapi heṭṭhimena upaḍḍhakāyena adissamānenapi uparimena upaḍḍhakāyena dhammaṃ desesi dissamānenapi uparimena upaḍḍhakāyena adissamānenapi heṭṭhimena upaḍḍhakāyena dhammaṃ desesi.
sn6.14:4.6: tatra sudaṃ bhikkhave brahmā ca brahmaparisā ca brahmapārisajjā ca acchariyabbhūtacittajātā ahesuṃ
sn6.14:4.7: acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhūtaṃ vata bho samaṇassa mahiddhikatā mahānubhāvatāti.
sn6.14:5.1: atha kho bhikkhave abhibhū bhikkhu sikhiṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ etadavoca
sn6.14:5.2: abhijānāmi khvāhaṃ bhante bhikkhusaṅghassa majjhe evarūpiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā
sn6.14:5.3: pahomi khvāhaṃ āvuso brahmaloke ṭhito sahassīlokadhātuṃ sarena viññāpetunti.
sn6.14:5.4: etassa brāhmaṇa kālo etassa brāhmaṇa kālo
sn6.14:5.5: yaṃ tvaṃ brāhmaṇa brahmaloke ṭhito sahassīlokadhātuṃ sarena viññāpeyyāsīti.
sn6.14:5.6: evaṃ bhanteti kho bhikkhave abhibhū bhikkhu sikhissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa paṭissutvā brahmaloke ṭhito imā gāthāyo abhāsi
sn6.14:8.1: atha kho bhikkhave sikhī ca bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho abhibhū ca bhikkhu brahmānañca brahmaparisañca brahmapārisajje ca saṃvejetvā
sn6.14:8.2: seyyathāpi nāma …pe… tasmiṃ brahmaloke antarahitā aruṇavatiyā rājadhāniyā pāturahesuṃ.
sn6.14:8.3: atha kho bhikkhave sikhī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho bhikkhū āmantesi
sn6.14:8.4: assuttha no tumhe bhikkhave abhibhussa bhikkhuno brahmaloke ṭhitassa gāthāyo bhāsamānassāti.
sn6.14:8.5: assumhā kho mayaṃ bhante abhibhussa bhikkhuno brahmaloke ṭhitassa gāthāyo bhāsamānassāti.
sn6.14:8.6: yathākathaṃ pana tumhe bhikkhave assuttha abhibhussa bhikkhuno brahmaloke ṭhitassa gāthāyo bhāsamānassāti.
sn6.14:8.7: evaṃ kho mayaṃ bhante assumhā abhibhussa bhikkhuno brahmaloke ṭhitassa gāthāyo bhāsamānassa
sn6.14:11.1: evaṃ kho mayaṃ bhante assumhā abhibhussa bhikkhuno brahmaloke ṭhitassa gāthāyo bhāsamānassāti.
sn6.14:11.3: sādhu kho tumhe bhikkhave assuttha abhibhussa bhikkhuno brahmaloke ṭhitassa gāthāyo bhāsamānassāti.
sn6.14:12.1: idamavoca bhagavā attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
